text:
Morgan: FYI, canary rollout for new RBAC policy hit an odd case — tokens minted before the refactor are being allowed on /v1/chat routes even though they only have embeddings scope. Repro steps and logs below.

Alina: Can you paste the log and the token id? :eyes:

Morgan: log:
```
AUTHZ[2026-03-19T21:15:03Z] token=tok_XX123 check=route:/v1/chat model:gpt-embed-v1 scopes:[embeddings] result=ALLOW source=policy-eval-cache
```
Looks like policy-eval-cache returned ALLOW despite policy rule requiring model:chat scope.

Ken: @morgan did the canary push change scope tag semantics (old tagkey -> new tagkey)? We did a metadata rename in the KMS rewrap last week.

Sanjay: Ran a quick query: some tokens still have metadata.tag=="legacy_scopes" which our new evaluator ignores, but the cache layer falls back to a permissive path when metadata lookup fails. That fallback is the culprit.

sec-infra-bot: [alert] 3 requests matched permissive fallback in last 5m for customer proj-47. Count=12

Alina: Ugh. So two problems: KMS rewrap renamed metadata key and cache fallback is too permissive. Agreed mitigation steps?

Ken: Immediate: 1) Disable permissive fallback in canary environ (flip flag) 2) Invalidate policy-eval-cache entries for tokens created before rewrap 3) Push hotfix to evaluator to treat missing metadata as DENY. I can do 1+2 now.

Morgan: I'll assemble list of affected token ids and prod user IDs and open an incident ticket. Also add a WIP PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rbac/pull/412

Sanjay: For longer term: update KMS rewrap to preserve legacy tag keys or write a migration job that copies legacy_scopes -> scopes (and add test). Also add an integration test that exercises post-rotate policy checks.

Alina: I'll file a compliance note and alert the audit team. We need a timeline (how long permissive window was live) and whether any customer data was accessed via escalated routes.

Morgan: First pass: window ~ 2026-03-19T20:58:00Z -> 2026-03-19T21:12:00Z. Minimal traffic but we should assume potential exposure. Assigning follow-ups: @ken will flip flag + invalidate cache; @morgan will run token scan and incident ticket; @alina will notify audit.

Ken: flipped flag and invalidated cache, patch deployed to canary. log:
```
CACHE[2026-03-19T21:20:01Z] evicted 1,224 policy entries
EVAL[2026-03-19T21:20:02Z] fallback_policy=DENY
```

sec-infra-bot: incident created INC-20260319-7

Alina: thanks. after postmortem let's add a non-permissive default to all evaluator branches and a CI gate that runs KMS rotate + authz smoke test.

Morgan: filing postmortem stub now. I'll add replication steps, logs, and mitigation timeline.

Ken: thx. keeping this thread as source of truth for now. :rotating_light:
